checks.detail: Rudelson--Vershynin Theorem 1.2 gives sqrt(2)K for normalized scalar sums of independent variables with densities <=K; Corollary 8.6 gives L(MY,tau||M||op)<=(C K tau)^r with r=floor(||M||HS^2/||M||op^2). No moment, support, log-concavity, iid, centering or symmetry hypothesis is introduced.
For A_II=0 the ambient cross term is 2 X_I^T B X_J; fleet03/B18 therefore gives ||p_Q||inf <= sqrt(2) C_RV ||B||op^-1 when the floored stable rank is >=2.
For x_j=sigma_j(B)^2 and R5=sum_{j>=5}x_j, e5(x)>=x1 e4(x2,...), while e4(y)>=(sum_{j>=4}y_j/4)^4. Hence e5(B^T B)>=sigma1^2(R5/4)^4.
If e5(B^T B)<2^-24 sigma1^10, then R5<sigma1^2/16, so the rank-four truncated SVD B4 obeys ||B-B4||HS<sigma1/4 and ||B-B4||op<sigma1/4.
For B=diag(1,1/4,1/4,1/4,1/4) and A=[[0,B,0],[B,0,0],[0,0,1]], the spectrum is {-1, +1, +1, -1/4^4, +1/4^4}; exactly three eigenvalues have modulus >=1.
||B||op=1 and ||B||HS^2=1+4/16=5/4, hence the Rudelson--Vershynin floored stable rank is one and the newest fleet03/B18 stable-rank density theorem is unavailable.

No arbitrary-joint coarea, conditional-cap-as-independence, post-rotation independence, fixed-good-minor claim, pointwise law-uniform phase decay, or deletion of the retained low-rank residual is used.
